title: Platform Ops Bridge: quicksync and rotations (2026-08-25)
content:
Agenda:
- Quick state from each area: control plane, routing, auth, quotas
- Oncall rotations and handoff notes
- Active triage items and decisions
- Action items and owners

Attendees:
Samira (bridge), Evan, Mohammed, Li, Grace, oncall: dykstra, rina

Summary (high level):
1) Control plane: deployment of 1.9.2 to canary completed, p99 CPU at 72% on canary nodes, memory stable. One regression observed in request fanout path (PLT-2412) leading to increased latency for long-context requests. Root cause suspected in new streaming buffer change. Rolling back buffer change in canary now (Evan).
2) Routing: new weight-based fallback policy roll by canary customers tomorrow; testing indicates correct header propagation but a certificate timeout surfaced in eu-west-1 for route-edge (PLT-2478). Mohammed is coordinating with infra to refresh cert chain.
3) Auth: short token refresh errors on Dedicated customers during heavy metadata calls; currently rate-limiting of the metadata service is mitigating but we need better caching. Li to prototype local token cache on agent side.
4) Quotas: quota accounting reconcile job missed run yesterday due to a cron drift in k8s jobs; Grace patched cronjob image and backfilled missing records. Potential stale quota windows may affect billing reports — finance notified.

Notable incidents and triage:
- Incident: PLT-2412 (control plane fanout latency). Timeline: 2026-08-24 22:12 saw p95 spike. Canary rollout paused. Evan identified streaming buffer mis-sizing. Immediate mitigation: revert buffer change on canary, throttle large-llm prefix requests for 2 hours. Follow-ups: load test with larger KV cache sizes; test against quantized kernels. Owner: Evan. Target next update: 2026-08-26.
- Incident: Cert timeout in eu-west-1 for route-edge (PLT-2478). Detected 2026-08-25 03:10 UTC. Symptom: TLS handshake failed intermittently for ~12% of requests for 15m. Root cause: intermediate cert expired on edge appliance. Mohammed to coordinate rotation and add certificate monitoring alert. Target completion: 2026-08-25 EOD.

Decisions made:
- Keep canary buffer change reverted until we have a synthetic that simulates 2x KV cache pressure (decision by Samira + Evan).
- Promote route-based fallback to limited GA for non-enterprise customers next week; enterprise customers to remain on pinned routing for now.

Action items (owner / due):
- Evan: revert buffer change in prod-canary and run stress harness with 2x tokens (due 2026-08-26).
- Mohammed: rotate edge intermediate cert and add uptime monitor (due 2026-08-25, in progress).
- Li: prototype agent-side token local cache and open PR with benchmarks (due 2026-09-01).
- Grace: backfill quota reconcile gaps and send summary to finance; include tentative MRR impact (due 2026-08-27).
- Samira: update oncall rota to include Rina for the weekend and write post-incident blameless notes (due 2026-08-25).

Rotation and handoff notes:
- Oncall this week: Dykstra (primary), Rina (secondary). Dykstra hands off to Rina on 2026-08-29 09:00 PST. Please ensure call-tree is validated before handoff.
- Bridge checklist: verify canary dashboards, check p99 latency, search for 502/524 spikes, confirm quota reconcile job status.

Open questions / parking lot:
- Do we accept short-term throttles on metadata service as an acceptable mitigation for Dedicated customers? (Li)
- Should we add a synthetic that exercises long-context streaming with backend fallback paths? (Evan)
- How to expose quota drift to customers proactively (Grace) — product input needed.

Quick wins and experiments:
- Try widening the streaming buffer only for models with small kv cache footprint (A/B experiment, Evan).
- Add simple LRU token cache with TTL to reduce metadata calls (Li will prototype).

Appendix - Raw notes & snippets:
- PLT-2412 logs (snippet): "fanout: dispatch 3 shards -> backend timeout 1.2s -> retry"; correlates with >4k token sequences.
- Slack refs: #platform-bridge-thread started at https://slack.redwood.ai/archives/CPLATFORM/p1623456789 (see pinned messages).
- PR referenced for buffer change: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/512

Notes-to-self / meeting friction:
- Keep meeting short (<=25m) next week; prefer async updates in the channel for non-blocking items.
- Need a clearer SLA for quota reconciliation; schedule meeting with finance/product.

Next check-in: 2026-08-27 quick sync (10m) to verify evan/mo commit and cert rotation.

End of notes.
